sloka: अथेन्द्रशत्रुं तरसा जघान बाणेन वज्राशनिसन्निभेन ।भुजान्तरे व्यूढसुजातरूपे वज्रेण मेरुं भगवानिवेन्द्रः ।। ६.५९.१३९ ।।।।
transliteration: athendraśatruṁ tarasā jaghāna bāṇena vajrāśanisannibhena ।bhujāntare vyūḍhasujātarūpe vajreṇa meruṁ bhagavānivendraḥ ।। 6.59.139 ।।।।

translations.english: Then with a shining thunderbolt like arrows Rama struck with the weapon of Indra into the fine chest in between the shoulders just as Indra would strike the Meru Mountain with his thunderbolt.
